orchestration: Claude Code Workflow tool, 240 parallel batches of 8 generation records each
blinding: Each judge call receives only: story_id, full_instruction, constraints[], and the generated text. model_id, model_name, condition, quant_file, seed, and all other provenance are held in a separate provenance map (evaluations/judge_provenance.json, not given to the judge) and re-attached to scores after judging.
temperature_intent: Low/deterministic scoring intended; exact sampling params are whatever the agent runtime uses by default for structured tool-call output (not separately configurable via the Workflow agent() call).

adherence.aggregate: I_i = mean(a_ik) over all constraints k for that story/record
adherence.output: per-constraint decision + short reason, not a single instruction-following score

craft.description: Prose quality: sentence-level control, word choice, mechanics.

anchors.1: Frequent grammar/word-choice errors; awkward or broken sentences throughout.
anchors.2: Serviceable but flat; noticeable repetition, clichéd phrasing, or clunky sentences.
anchors.3: Competent, clean prose; some varied sentence structure; no major errors.
anchors.4: Polished, controlled prose; effective word choice; rhythm supports the writing.
anchors.5: Distinctive, highly controlled prose; every sentence earns its place.

structure_coherence.description: Narrative structure and coherence, merged (collapsed from the original 6-dimension proposal since they correlate heavily at this story length).

anchors.1: Incoherent or contradictory; events don't follow logically; hard to follow.
anchors.2: Followable but disjointed; unclear transitions; loose ends.
anchors.3: Clear structure; events follow logically; minor rough transitions.
anchors.4: Well-organized; transitions are smooth; builds effectively toward its ending.
anchors.5: Tight, purposeful structure; every part serves the whole; ending lands.

originality.description: Avoids cliché/generic execution of the premise (not 'is this an original premise' -- the premise is fixed by the task; this scores execution).

anchors.1: Generic/cliché execution; premise handled in the most predictable possible way.
anchors.2: Mostly predictable with a token twist.
anchors.3: Some fresh choices in how the premise is executed (voice, detail, angle).
anchors.4: Notably fresh take; avoids obvious clichés; surprises without breaking plausibility.
anchors.5: Highly original execution; memorable, unexpected choices throughout.

genre_effectiveness.description: Does the story deliver on genre-specific expectations (mystery has real intrigue, comedy is actually funny, romance has real chemistry, etc.)?

anchors.1: Fails to deliver core genre expectations.
anchors.2: Weak genre delivery; genre markers present but not functioning.
anchors.3: Adequate genre delivery; recognizably does what the genre asks.
anchors.4: Strong genre delivery; effectively produces the genre's intended effect.

characterization.description: Optional/conditional dimension. Score null with characterization_na=true when the task specifies no character-related requirement and the text does not develop identifiable characters as a meaningful axis -- do not force a score onto stories where this isn't applicable.

anchors.1: Characters are flat, contradictory, or not distinguishable.
anchors.2: Minimal characterization; traits stated but not shown.
anchors.3: Adequate; characters behave consistently with stated traits.
anchors.4: Vivid; characters feel specific and distinct through action/voice.
anchors.5: Exceptional; characters feel fully realized despite the short form.

notes: This rubric collapses the original 6-proposed-dimension list (creativity/originality, coherence, prose quality, narrative structure, characterization, genre effectiveness) to 5 by merging coherence+narrative structure, which correlate heavily for stories at this length (6 sentences to ~1500 words).
characterization is explicitly nullable to avoid penalizing tasks that never asked for developed characters.
Pairwise blind A/B evaluation (spec Phase 4C) is not implemented in this pass -- only per-record adherence + quality scoring.
